name: @abhisri2090/aipm-package-prep
description: Convert existing AI skills and helper files into upload-ready AIPM skill packages.
usage: Use this skill when preparing a Cursor, Claude, Codex, or local skill folder for AIPM publishing.
agentDescription: Use this skill to interview the user, inspect an existing skill folder or related files, classify permanent versus temporary setup assets, and produce an AIPM package with a valid manifest, optional helper files, optional main files, and optional manual setup prompt.

examples.title: Package a local skill
examples.description: Turn an existing skill folder into an AIPM package.
examples.prompt: Package this Cursor skill folder for AIPM upload. Ask me the required questions first.

examples.title: Package a setup-heavy skill
examples.description: Create a hybrid skill package with helper files and a manual setup prompt.
examples.prompt: Convert this debug helper skill into an AIPM package with helper setup files and a prompt users can run manually.

releaseNotes: Initial self-contained packaging interview and AIPM package creation workflow.
